notes: Apply each matching direction as a contextual correction to palette-guidance.json; preserve the original brief and compatible material colors. Unlisted IDs retain base guidance. This is guidance, not art approval or a generation manifest.

None of the 100 local spirit briefs requires new flags, crowns, national arms, party insignia or aircraft roundels. National cases, Aquileian/Griffish language books, imperial offices and autonomous_crown IDs do not authorize heraldry. No invented lilies, seals, logos, humans/hands, pseudo-text or blank documents.

Keep diagram-only roofs, buildings, gears and maps as meaningful marks within their paper/slate surface. A keyword material assignment must not create extra physical props. Workshop, factory, field, order and binding can describe context rather than a separate object.

Rations and provisions keep natural food colors only when visible in the unchanged brief; cloth rules cover wrapping. Earthworks use soil/turf. Metal equipment stays metal; no universal gold outline or cobalt shadow wash.

Communicate benefits, penalties and mixed effects through the briefed open/closed, aligned/broken, used/unused or constrained object states. Negative numeric costs or training-time modifiers can be beneficial. Do not use automatic red=bad or green=good.

Preserve separate keys, explicit assent clasps, finite guardianship, independent institutions and bounded presidential authority. Imperial/dynastic terminology is not permission for annexation imagery or invented crowns.
64x64 readability, transparent exterior and distinct silhouettes remain required. Use one dominant assembly and only supporting motifs already in the brief.

The first ten local spirits are already in generation and have user-reported visual review, including the officer slate. This file does not revoke approvals or request regeneration; apply corrections where needed, based on actual reviewed pixels.

records.direction: Training slate is dark slate #515B59 with readable pale tactical marks, not ivory paper. Baton uses natural wood or restrained metal fittings. Retain the existing brief; this clarification alone does not require regenerating visually reviewed art.
Use logistics material balance: pale packing timber crate, dark iron fittings and a restrained clock face/rim. The civil_access category does not authorize gates, keys or additional civic props.
Roof/building is a diagram in the maintenance register, not a separate stone roof prop. Ivory pages with meaningful charcoal diagram, fabric tool carrier and metal tools; no extra architecture.

Gear is drawn in the technical diagram, not an extra physical metal gear. Ivory diagram surface, meaningful charcoal marks and natural counters; the explicitly illuminating study lamp permits a small warm light.
Defensive earthwork is cut soil and turf, not stone/concrete. Use muted umber soil, restrained sage turf and steel shovel with a natural wood handle.

Textile applies only to ration wrapping or case lining, not food. Keep the sealed ration case closed as briefed; natural timber shelf, restrained storage finish and matching tally counters. Do not add exposed food merely to demonstrate its palette.

Field means deployed telescope, not crops. Use dark metal optics and restrained grey-green glass. Ridge is carefully sketched: use drawing marks, not added vegetation or a physical landscape backdrop.

Keep the broken agreement lock and civilian crate being lifted clearly visible. Military output benefit accompanies lower stability and greater consumer-goods burden; do not portray consensual or cost-free cooperation.

Override agriculture_food direction with justice_charters: balanced oxidised-bronze/iron judicial scale above two equal pale-stone courthouse thresholds. No crops, straw, food or agricultural decoration.

Ignore crop assignment triggered by field-hospital. Use linen-white bandages/cot fabric, muted medical glass, dark metal supports, timber crate and restrained hourglass fittings. No vegetation, invented red-cross emblem or permanent-service implication.

New earthworks are soil/turf rather than concrete bunkers. Keep lookout shelter and temporary clock distinct; muted earth and natural shelter materials with dark metal fittings, not a solid stone fort.
Binding describes judicial authority, not cloth: omit the burgundy cloth assignment. Use metal keys and a balanced bronze/iron scale, preserving two independent keys at equal status.

Field telephone is charcoal bakelite/iron with restrained copper connectors, not crops. Map cases retain natural leather/storage materials and ivory calculations. National describes the two separate cases, not permission to add flags or national colors.

Use civic_deliberation material balance: modest walnut chair and bounded council rail, with restrained metal fittings. Rail is civic furniture, not railway track. No throne, crown or sovereign emblem.

Keep tense closed civic gate beneath central lever and workshop gear. Military/industrial gains accompany a stability loss. Order denotes command, not a new storage object; workshop does not authorize added masonry scenery.

Retain closed petition hatch beneath dispatch rod and arsenal/factory machinery. Organisation/output gains coexist with lower stability; no triumphant crown, added regalia or unqualified welfare framing.
Preserve narrow civic-access slot beneath central spindle/gears: political/output/military gains accompany a stability cost. Natural machine metal/paint, not an invented ducal emblem.
Keep displaced claimant case closed beneath estate key and patron sword. Attack benefit carries stability and political costs; no invented noble crest or impartial-justice framing.

Keep military chain retaining the civilian workshop wheel despite the arrived release key. Military output benefits carry stability/consumer-goods costs. Workshop is context for the metal wheel, not permission to add a stone building.

Open garrison lock and returning workshop key express civilian recovery, while army organisation falls. Preserve that tradeoff; no universal military-upgrade treatment or additional workshop building.

Textile applies only to provisions wrapping, not household food. Keep basket woven and constrained beneath the command tower. Organisation/planning benefits coexist with stability and consumer-goods costs; preserve the restrictive composition.

Unused stool, discharged pack and closed workshop door must read as exclusion/inactivity. Both stability and civilian construction are penalised. Use worn natural materials and object state, not an arbitrary red danger badge.

Retain the scheduling wheel largest allocation to shells and waiting civilian repairs. Military output rises while civilian construction slows; distinguish competing allocations, not an unconditional production improvement.

Allied field radios require charcoal radio housings, copper contacts and restrained instrument glass; ignore crop assignment. Keep defensive map as a diagram and preserve each radio own key, without flags or implied annexation.
Keep controlled visitor screen and closed outside book: greater political control accompanies lower research. Natural desk/book materials; no crown or implication of open academic exchange.
Preserve sword protecting estate key while petition box stays closed. Organisation benefit accompanies stability loss; do not depict equal judicial access or add patron heraldry.
Building is a diagram inside the public-project register, not an extra stone building. Use ivory paper with meaningful charcoal construction marks and a metal accountable office key.

Retain two equally open books and the briefed modest teaching purse. Use differentiated sage/russet/plum bindings without national identities. The idea definition grants research and stability bonuses, with no ongoing expense modifier; do not turn the purse into an asserted recurring gameplay penalty.

Use logistics direction rather than civil_access: timber ration crate, clock and metal planning compass. Field is not crops; textile applies only to packaging, not ration contents. Do not add gates, vegetation or exposed food.

Home-terrain earthwork is soil/turf, not stone bunker. Keep khaki reserve kit and metal canteen distinct. Defence/recovery benefits coexist with slower planning; avoid presenting this as an unconditional command upgrade.

Government keyring is metal, not records-storage enamel or wood. Keep unfinished budget abacus visibly distinct from the factory wheel; new government is not yet the fully settled institutional stage.

Railway/logistics direction fits the dispatch lever, track-maintenance diagram and military cargo better than a whole-icon field-service tint. Dark iron lever, ivory meaningful plan and natural packing materials; no authority over another crown railways is implied.

Kit can be khaki cloth, rack/basket natural timber or woven fibre; household provisions are not textile except their wrapping. Preserve visibly strained household provision alongside organised officer kit: military gains carry a stability cost.

Use logistics/field-service materials rather than civil_access: compact khaki pack, restrained clock and practical supply case. Reduced training time and supply consumption are benefits; rationed provision does not make this a penalty icon.
